name: lead(II) nitrate
provenance: M from IUPAC/CIAAW 2021 atomic weights; density standard reference. Dissolution enthalpy +35.4 kJ/mol derived from NBS/Wagman 1982 formation enthalpies: Pb(NO3)2(s) -451.9, Pb2+(aq) -1.7, NO3-(aq) -207.4 kJ/mol, so -1.7 + 2(-207.4) + 451.9 = +35.4. Cp(s) 145 is an ESTIMATE from the nitrates' range, not a sourced value, and nothing computed depends on it while the salt is dissolved
